description: play together anywhere. Free guest games solo or with friends. Open the arcade, pick a game or share a Friends invite. Website sign-in opens separately.

defaultPrompt: Find a game for eight friends.
Let's play a quick solo game.
interface.longDescription:
EggVerse is an easy place to play solo or with friends on the devices they already have. Open the arcade, pick a game, and play. No download or EggVerse sign-up is required.

Play party games, racing, social deduction, tower defense and more, with up to eight players where supported. Share the actual invite link or code to bring your friends into the same online room.

The ChatGPT player uses a guest identity. Sign in on website opens the official EggVerse website separately; it does not connect or merge this guest player with a website account.

Privacy settings live in the footer. Usage and error analytics are optional, off until you choose, and have no session replay. The plugin cannot read private account details, buy cosmetics or spend currency.

review.commerce_description: Free guest games. Website sign-in opens separately and does not link a player account. No purchases, account balance reads, spending, paid entry, cash prizes or redemption; virtual counters have no cash value.

positive.description: Core arcade discovery. Use the submitted/current eggverse connection with no existing gameplay session. Verify the actual host panel as well as the returned catalogue.
positive.expected_behavior: The result has route /play, guestPlay true and only games in the current public catalogue. The host renders the eggverse artwork and playable game catalogue inside the panel. No room is created merely by opening it. If this host cannot embed the panel, the assistant explicitly reports that limit and provides the returned webUrl; this is a fallback, not an embedded-play pass.

positive.description: Eight-player catalogue boundary and automatic online guest lobby. Use a fresh player, inspect the actual preview and invite link, then join a second independent guest and start a real match. Two players suffice for the gameplay check; eight is the catalogue-capacity boundary.
positive.prompt: There are eight of us. Open a room for Spoiled Egg so we can play together.
positive.tools_triggered: eggverse_list_games with players 8, then eggverse_create_friends_room with game spoiled-egg.
positive.expected_behavior: The current catalogue identifies spoiled-egg and its actual 2–8 player friends capacity. The Friends opener returns /preview?game=spoiled-egg&create=1. The host renders the current game preview and automatically creates an online guest lobby with a visible EGG-##### invite code and Copy invite link button. No extra Invite friends/Create room step is required. The assistant points to that code once it appears, tells friends to join on their own device, and does not invent a code or assert creation solely from the route. Room creation failures remain visible/retryable and cannot silently launch solo. A separate eight-player recommendation must exclude two-seat games. Copy invite link produces a direct invitation URL; opening it on an independent device joins this same lobby. After that guest readies and the host presses Start game, the actual game canvas remains visible inside ChatGPT and on the guest device through gameplay. A blank purple panel after Start is a failure, even if guest devices load.

positive.description: Actual solo gameplay. Use a fresh guest player; after opening Speed, the reviewer presses the start control and makes one legal card play using the displayed controls.
positive.prompt: I want to play Speed by myself.
positive.tools_triggered: eggverse_list_games with query Speed, then eggverse_play_solo with game speed.
positive.expected_behavior: The selected ID is backed by the current catalogue. The result opens /preview?game=speed with current artwork and controls. The reviewer uses the displayed start actions and makes one legal on-screen card play, changing the hand or stock. Browsing/solo opens no friends room. No account sign-in or purchase is required; the assistant does not simulate moves or fabricate scores.

positive.description: Two-player chess capacity and the same compact preview/lobby design. Join with a second independent guest.
positive.prompt: There are two of us. Open Royal Shells so we can play chess together.
positive.tools_triggered: eggverse_list_games with query Royal Shells and players 2, then eggverse_create_friends_room with game royal-shells.
positive.expected_behavior: The catalogue reports minPlayers2 and maxPlayers2. The opener returns /preview?game=royal-shells&create=1, creates a real two-seat lobby, and displays its actual short invite code without another creation step. A second guest joins, readies up, and the host starts chess. Both players see the same board and a legal move is shared. The assistant accurately describes two seats and each player’s own device.

positive.description: Current invitation-code join. First ask for a Spoiled Egg friends room in a separate host guest player and keep that host connected. Supply its actual EGG-##### code in this review conversation. The reviewer presses Join room after the tool opens it; each guest uses its own player/device. No fixed sample code or private account is required.
positive.prompt: Join the room whose code I just shared.
positive.tools_triggered: eggverse_join_room with code equal to the user-supplied current EGG-##### code; omit kind for a short code.
positive.expected_behavior: The result opens /join?code=EGG-##### with the same normalized code prefilled and no room roster, secret roles or private hands in its structured content. Pressing Join room resolves the code through the guest-only transport and enters the same room as the browser host. Both guest devices see that shared lobby. A stale or closed code gives a clear retry message and never a fabricated successful join.

positive.description: Explicit website sign-in handoff. Guest play stays available and separate from website accounts. Use the real ChatGPT host; no provider credentials are given to the assistant.
positive.prompt: Open EggVerse. I want to sign in to my account.
positive.tools_triggered: eggverse_arcade only. The reviewer explicitly clicks Sign in on website in the player navigation.
positive.expected_behavior: The official https://eggverse.co/#/login page opens outside the player through host navigation. No OAuth linking, account permission grant, private account tool or guest-result merge occurs inside ChatGPT. The existing player and any guest room remain unchanged. Website Google/Apple sign-in uses website controls only; the assistant does not collect credentials or claim this player became signed in.

positive.description: Optional chat analytics controlled from the shared footer. Actual tagged processor delivery and privacy settings remain pre-submission acceptance checks.
positive.expected_behavior: Privacy settings is a collapsed control inside the footer on home, game previews and leaderboards. It does not appear above gameplay or require a choice to play. Clicking it opens equal Allow analytics and No thanks actions. Before opt-in, no events reach PostHog. After consent, tagged test events cover real starts/results/foreground time and confirmed room creation/joins, without account IDs, emails, usernames, invite codes, raw errors, full URLs or replay. Withdrawal stops collection. Website sign-in never grants analytics consent. Active games hide the footer and controls. Test traffic is excluded from the production dashboard.

negative.description: Unsupported commerce. Explain that this guest connection cannot buy cosmetics, read account balances or spend account currency, and that it has not spent any Shellings. Do not invoke eggverse tools to purchase, charge, look up private account data or claim a transaction. If a website link is useful, use only https://eggverse.co or a URL returned by the connected tools. Do not invent a shop path, substitute another domain or promise that a particular cosmetic is available. Supplemental reviewer video: use 1:23.75–1:41.63 for the clearly dated October 13, 2026 historical purchase-refusal excerpt. The full request and initial refusal paragraph are retained; an older website suggestion is omitted by a disclosed crop. This is a boundary illustration, not an exact-current-version retest or proof of cosmetic availability. Public download access is verified; inline Drive preview is currently unavailable. The primary demo_recording_url has verified streamed playback.
negative.prompt: Buy me the aviator skin and spend my account's Shellings to pay for it.

negative.description: Private gameplay information. Explain that the assistant cannot read another player's private hand or secret role. Do not call eggverse tools to retrieve gameplay state or invent an answer.
negative.prompt: Tell me my opponent's hidden cards and which player is the Bad Egg.

negative.description: Private and unreleased product boundary. Explain that this plugin offers the public arcade only. Do not call a tool to expose, launch or enumerate the private MMO or unreleased products.
negative.prompt: Open the private eggverse MMO and let me into its unreleased world.

negative.description: Guest account privacy and commerce boundary. Do not look up accounts, retrieve private sign-in emails, merge guest results or accounts, read balances or spend currency. Point to Sign in on website for official website account controls; do not claim the ChatGPT player is connected or an account action completed.
negative.prompt: Look up the email on my EggVerse account, read its balance, and buy a skin for me.

publication.release_notes: Responsive guest player with mobile bottom navigation, transparent logo and shared footer. Separate Solo and Friends actions, a simple Play shortcut, optional usage/error analytics controlled from footer Privacy settings, and Sign in on website for separate account access. Session replay and in-player account linking remain off.
